query_original: What does the FIA F1 Technical Regulations define as the 'Power Unit'?
query_reformulada: What are the technical specifications and definitions for the Power Unit as outlined in Article 2.1 of the FIA Formula One World Championship 2026 Technical Regulations?
resposta: The FIA F1 Technical Regulations define the 'Power Unit' as a constituent element of the Power Unit, as set out within the first column of the tables within Appendix E2.

. “2022 PU”: Power Unit designed to comply with the 2022-2025 Technical Regulations “2026 PU”: Power Unit under development, intended to comply with the 2026-2030 Technical Regulations, including any preliminary components or work leading to that ultimate goal. 2026 Formula 1: Operational Regulations 07 May 2026 F3 1 2026 Fédération Internationale de l’Automobile Issue 08
